name: orbit
description: Track your logtime and know exactly when to leave with integrated transit departures.

scripts.build: echo 'No build process needed for manifest v3'
scripts.dev: echo 'Load extension in Chrome developer mode'
scripts.xpi: jar cf Orbit.xpi manifest.json mainPage.js assets/
scripts.version: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json')); m.version = process.env.npm_package_version; fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));" && git add manifest.json
scripts.bump: read -p 'Version (major, minor, patch): ' v && npm version $v -m 'release: v%s' && read -p 'Confirmer le push ? (y/n): ' confirm && [[ $confirm == "y" ]] && git push --follow-tags

author: Guilheim C, Clement R
